shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'README*' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'dashboard|chart|grid|drag|widget' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && find . -name AGENTS.md -not -path './node_modules/*' -print"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files | head -100; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; sed -n '1,200p' src/main.tsx; rg -n 'dashkit|@gravity-ui/charts' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit'
/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Text Icon'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Text Icon'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n -C 3 'DashKit|register|plugins|layout|widget|onLayout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -160; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json; rg -n 'export.*(Button|Card|Text|Icon)|interface ButtonProps|type ButtonProps|interface CardProps|variant:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Button,Card,Text,Icon}/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; rg -n 'DashKitDnDWrapper|styles.css|css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; rg -n -C 4 'DashKitDnDWrapper|ActionPanel|dnd' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -160; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg '\\.(css|scss)"'$'"' | head -20; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; sed -n '408,480p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/Plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface Plugin|type Plugin|renderer:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/Config.d.ts 2>/dev/null; "

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.css 2>/dev/null; "

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/common.d.ts | rg -n 'ItemsStateAndParams|ItemStateAndParams'; rg -n 'DashKitDnDWrapper|ActionPanel' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '481,525p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head -80; rg -n 'g-action-panel' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'widget-remove|DashKitDnDWrapper|nav-button|widget-drawer' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface Settings|gridLayout:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/*.d.ts; rg -o --no-filename -- '--g-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+' src/App.css | sort -u > /tmp/theme_tokens.txt; while IFS= read -r token; do rg -l --fixed-strings \""'$token:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed "s#''^#$token #"; done < /tmp/theme_tokens.txt'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts | head -70; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'styles.css"'$|theme.*css$'"' | head; head -100 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | rg -n 'styles|GridLayout|DashKitView' -C 1; node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css','utf8'); const x=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/theme_tokens.txt','utf8').trim().split(/\\\\n/); console.log(x.filter(t=>"'!css.includes(t+'"':')).join('\\\\n'))\"; "
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'positive|success' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/{base,text,line,system}.scss | head -60; cat /tmp/theme_tokens.txt"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js; "

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && git status --short && node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css','utf8'); const tokens=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/theme_tokens.txt','utf8').trim().split(/\\\\n/); console.log('Missing theme tokens:', tokens.filter(t=>"'!css.includes(t+'"':')).join(', ') || 'none')\" "

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css','utf8'); const app=fs.readFileSync('src/App.css','utf8'); const tokens=[...new Set(app.match(/--g-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+/g)||[])]; console.log(tokens.filter(t=>"'!css.includes(t+'"':')).join(', ') || 'All referenced theme tokens exist in installed uikit styles.');\"; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,30p;70,180p'; nl -ba src/App.css | sed -n '1,30p'; cat package.json"
